title: coding-study test document
description: `cstudy test --json`: one document per run. The variants differ in their required fields: `single-file` has `build` and `perf`, `project` has `stopped_early`, and `service` has `tests` and `startup_s`. Spec: docs/specs/cli.md#json-output

single-file.description: A run of a function, design, progressive or concurrent problem

outcome.description: `build_failed` comes with `build.diagnostics`, `load_failed` with `load_error`; `cases` and `stress` are empty then

exit_code.description: 0 when every graded case passed, 1 when one did not, 2 when the code did not load or build

every_case.description: Whether the run graded every case: false with `--case`

comparator.description: The problem's comparator, such as `unordered`; null for the exact one

time_limit.description: The time limit of the run, such as `5x` or `1500ms`; null when limits were off

timer.description: The `--timer` time box, or null without one

levels.description: A progressive problem's levels, or null

load_error.description: Why the code did not load, or null

diagnostics.description: The diagnostics of code that did not load or build

cases.description: Every case in run order, passing hidden ones included; oracle inputs are in `oracle`

oracle.description: `--stress N` on a problem that is not concurrent, else null

project.description: A run of a project problem's suite

exit_code.description: 0 when every graded case passed, 1 when one did not, 2 when the code did not load or build

every_case.description: Whether the run ran every test

comparator.description: Always null: a suite is the framework's verdict

timer.description: The `--timer` time box, or null without one

levels.description: The levels the run covered, or null

load_error.description: Why the suite did not load, or null

diagnostics.description: The diagnostics of code that did not load or type check

cases.description: Every test of the suite, in run order

stopped_early.description: Why the suite stopped before its last test; null when it ran through

service.description: A run of a service project's `commands.test` and visible cases

outcome.description: `load_failed` when the stack did not become ready

exit_code.description: 0 when every graded case passed, 1 when one did not, 2 when the code did not load or build

levels.description: The levels of the attempt, or null

load_error.description: Why the stack did not become ready, or null

tests.description: `commands.test`; empty when the stack did not become ready

startup_s.description: The first clock: the stack's startup, which nothing counts

duration_s.description: The second clock: `commands.test` and the cases

error.description: An exception of the code, or why it could not be loaded

trace.description: Filtered to the frames of your code, at most 10 lines

diagnostic.description: A problem a compiler, a type checker or the loader reported

file.description: Relative to the project folder; null when the report names none

line.description: From 1; null when the report names none

column.description: From 1; null when the report names none

code.description: The tool's name for the problem, such as `TS2322`

levels.description: The levels of a progressive or project problem the run covered

unlocked.description: Levels 1 to this one are open

build.description: The build before the run; a project folder builds nothing

diagnostics.description: The compiler's or type checker's lines when the build failed

case.description: A case the run judged; what did not pass adds what the report shows for it

id.description: The case's ID in `tests.json`, or the ID of a generated case

duration_ns.description: The runner's measurement of the call; null when the call did not finish

input.description: The `tests.json` encoding of the input: arguments by name, or `ops` and `args`, cut after the failing operation

expected.description: A wrong answer: the expected value

actual.description: A wrong answer: the value the code returned

reason.description: Why the output was rejected, why a case did not run or stalled; null for a wrong answer without a detail

op_index.description: The operation that raised or stalled

partial_output.description: What the operations before the exception returned

hang_guard_ms.description: A case that timed out: the hang guard it exceeded

exit_code.description: A crash: the runner's exit code

stderr.description: A crash: the tail of the runner's standard error

time_limit_ms.description: A case that was too slow: the limit it exceeded

time_limit_basis.description: Why that limit; null for an absolute one

leveled_case.description: A case with the level it belongs to

id.description: The case's ID in `tests.json`, or the ID of a generated case

duration_ns.description: The runner's measurement of the call; null when the call did not finish

input.description: The `tests.json` encoding of the input: arguments by name, or `ops` and `args`, cut after the failing operation

expected.description: A wrong answer: the expected value

actual.description: A wrong answer: the value the code returned

reason.description: Why the output was rejected, why a case did not run or stalled; null for a wrong answer without a detail

op_index.description: The operation that raised or stalled

partial_output.description: What the operations before the exception returned

hang_guard_ms.description: A case that timed out: the hang guard it exceeded

exit_code.description: A crash: the runner's exit code

stderr.description: A crash: the tail of the runner's standard error

time_limit_ms.description: A case that was too slow: the limit it exceeded

time_limit_basis.description: Why that limit; null for an absolute one

level.description: The level the case belongs to; null when it names none

oracle_input.description: An input of the oracle: a case with the seed and size it was generated from

id.description: The case's ID in `tests.json`, or the ID of a generated case

duration_ns.description: The runner's measurement of the call; null when the call did not finish

expected.description: A wrong answer: the expected value

actual.description: A wrong answer: the value the code returned

op_index.description: The operation that raised or stalled

partial_output.description: What the operations before the exception returned

hang_guard_ms.description: A case that timed out: the hang guard it exceeded

exit_code.description: A crash: the runner's exit code

stderr.description: A crash: the tail of the runner's standard error

time_limit_ms.description: A case that was too slow: the limit it exceeded

time_limit_basis.description: Why that limit; null for an absolute one

variant.description: The thread kind of a JVM run, else the language's only model

median_ms.description: Null without a run that finished

failures.description: Every run that did not pass

stress_failure.description: A run of a stress case that did not pass

suite_test.description: A test of a project's suite, or `commands.test` of a service project

id.description: The framework's ID of the test

duration_ns.description: Null for a test that did not finish

origin.description: Whose tests the file holds: the generated file of a level, the starter's or yours

level.description: The level of a generated test file; null for any other file

expected.description: A failed assertion that reports both sides: the expected value

actual.description: A failed assertion that reports both sides: the actual value

error.description: An exception of the code, or the crash of the runner

oracle.description: `--stress N` on a problem that is not concurrent: the approach and every judged input

approach.description: The approach that gives the expected values

perf.description: `--perf`: the time verdict of a short bench after a full pass

text.description: The verdict line the report prints, or why there is none

wrong_answer.description: The line that says which size answered wrongly; null otherwise
